title: Installed from the tap on kovacs (Ubuntu 26.04.1, aarch64)
objective: The same as WP-02 on kovacs, Ubuntu 26.04.1 aarch64 under Homebrew on Linux, with uutils as coreutils and mawk as awk; the formula's on_macos bash dependency does not apply, so Ubuntu's bash meets the bash >= 5 floor. Run as a kovacs order with brew taken from its full path; brew on hv's login PATH there is hv's choice and not this package's.
